detail:
New decision "Chose controller-commits with working-tree review packages over subagent commits" relates to:
- 01KJC68KWE17FYM6D111ZD4PVM: "Add project name to dashboard title/header and GitHub icon link — fixes #2 and #3"
- 01KJJ340SQV8S2GN1S4FWXMKBP: "Redesign dashboard UI with dark-first professional theme using Sora/DM Sans/JetBrains Mono fonts and teal accent color"
- 01KJJ348G20Z2SYKBZ8WNXDQME: "Prevent duplicate browser tabs by checking health endpoint before auto-opening"
- 01KJJ34D0940TD59ET8M9TY5E2: "Show session-ended overlay after 3 consecutive poll failures instead of attempting window.close()"
- 01KJJCBK7NW40PQ9RE2625AJ9B: "Fix timeline zoom by changing overflow:auto to overflow:hidden and add zoom controls toolbar"
- 01KJJE3F7YJJBF74FJWVP4ESHK: "Replace search bar multi-select with toggle chips, add search icon, and style filters to match toolbar design language"
- 01KJJZFSFB5CD2Q804A0HGJCMB: "Include projectRoot in health endpoint to distinguish same-project vs different-project dashboard instances"
- 01KX3HED595XAZC4AT4F1VP8FM: "Recommended scale-native redesign of timeline/graph/lists (canvas density timeline, aggregated meta-graph + ego-network explorer capped ~200 nodes, server-windowed virtual lists, new Health panel, scope as first-class drill-down) over (a) conservative retrofit of vis-timeline/cytoscape which both lack aggregation modes and would stay mediocre, and (b) full framework rewrite which touches all 7 tabs to fix 3 and adds a build toolchain to a zero-config npm package. Not yet user-approved"
- 01KX3HRWR3J2ETM9A6X2S9NDEB: "Chose to keep vanilla JS split into native ES modules over adding a build step"
- 01KX3HRWV1666F03M5X0N7NTXA: "Chose to delete vis-timeline but retain cytoscape"
- 01KX3HRWZ3GC6R2VP672AP8E65: "Added .playwright-mcp/ to .gitignore"
- 01KX3SE6BRPB8YZVT9JCT00CMR: "Chose transitional coexistence of legacy app.js and new ES modules (main.js mounts new views per tab, window.__twiningStore bridge, legacy renderers deleted task-by-task) over a big-bang module conversion of the 3454-line app.js"
- 01KX49RDJF27SKMRYFF6FW8S38: "Chose a feature branch (dashboard-scale-redesign) over committing the redesign directly to main"
summary: Related decisions in scope: 13 existing decision(s) overlap
